title: Back doors in 1904 stand in their houses' walls
items: Every back door and its steps now sit in the house's built rear wall. Before, 56 of 121 stood out in the yard, 1626 Prairie's 16 m from its house.
124 houses have a back door, terrace and walks laid against the wall that is really there.
A house whose rear has no clear stretch of wall gets no back door rather than one in the wrong place.
